hypothesis: Most visible capitulum diversity is continuous and substantial below taxon means rather than only among named taxa
meta_or_existing_result: Across nine Azami endpoints 0.589-0.931 of visible image variance occurs below assigned-taxon means
unresolved_reason: Image variance is not genetic variance or adaptation

hypothesis: Orientation and visible colour are more environmentally structured than gross outline at global extent
meta_or_existing_result: Orientation and colour retain the clearest within/among-taxon environmental structure; global gross-outline support is weaker/model-dependent
unresolved_reason: Environment association does not identify causal agent or evolutionary direction
decisive_next_data: Focal causal tests and ancestry-resolved mapping
claim_boundary: No local-adaptation or pollinator-causation claim from Azami

hypothesis: Seasonality covaries with involucre/spine-like geometry within taxa
meta_or_existing_result: BIO4 positive for roughness 0.0975 spread 0.0937 and max spine-like projection 0.0911; q=0.0424
unresolved_reason: 2D image proxies are not botanical spine/phyllary states and do not show defence
decisive_next_data: Direct spine/phyllary measurement plus antagonist manipulation

hypothesis: Pollinator- versus antagonist-mediated selection has no universal fixed dominant agent and forms a context-dependent selection mosaic
meta_or_existing_result: Five strict factorial programmes: antagonist-dominant 2; pollinator-dominant 1; mixed/no-fixed 2; >=2 categories remain under every leave-one-program-out
self_analysis_role: Provides general selection architecture for Aim2
unresolved_reason: Cross-species synthesis cannot assign dominance in focal Cirsium populations
decisive_next_data: Same-population pollination supplementation x post-anthesis antagonist protection on one seed-fitness scale
claim_boundary: General mechanism supported; focal dominance unidentified

hypothesis: Pollinator dependence is not equivalent to current pollen limitation because reproductive assurance buffers realized limitation
meta_or_existing_result: Six independent Cirsium studies; high dependence common but open pollen deficit often absent/context-dependent; assurance varies with selfing donor spacing synchrony density
self_analysis_role: Defines local assurance as a gate rather than visitation abundance
unresolved_reason: Heterogeneous estimands block one pooled genus-wide RR
decisive_next_data: Nested bagged/open/supplemented heads plus donor distance density overlap effective contacts and seed fitness

hypothesis: Reproductive insect antagonists impose a large direct fecundity cost
meta_or_existing_result: 4 independent data-generation studies; 9 contrasts; reduced-herbivory seed-output RR=2.674 95% CI 2.388-2.993; ambient loss equivalent 62.6%
self_analysis_role: Sets magnitude of antagonist pressure before trait-specific experiments
unresolved_reason: Does not identify which capitulum trait mediates the cost
decisive_next_data: Trait manipulation linked to damage and final seed output

hypothesis: The same fecundity effect can transmit or disappear at the seed-to-recruitment bottleneck depending on safe sites disturbance and density dependence
meta_or_existing_result: 6 studies/4 taxa: transmission consistent 4 context-dependent 1 blocked 1; explicit demographic gate support 3/4
self_analysis_role: Separates reproductive fitness from population consequence
unresolved_reason: Recruitment/IPM outputs are heterogeneous and focal populations may differ
decisive_next_data: Conditional seed-addition x microsite pilot after a focal seed-output contrast
claim_boundary: Do not pool heterogeneous population-growth metrics

hypothesis: Biotic selection strength is not determined by broad floral functional class or interaction intensity alone
meta_or_existing_result: 38 primary standardized gradients/6 articles/6 taxa; no significant article-paired functional-class contrast; Lobelia pollen limitation 0.062->0.259 but only 4/6 traits strengthened
unresolved_reason: Small orchid-heavy validation set; not a replacement for larger published meta-analyses
decisive_next_data: Measure trait->effective-contact and trait->damage slopes in each focal population
claim_boundary: Selection = opportunity x local leverage x downstream gate is working synthesis

hypothesis: Increasing floral display can increase mutualist attraction while also increasing predispersal seed-predator exposure
meta_or_existing_result: Cirsium purpuratum visitation/heads probed increase with display and density context; seed-predation probability also rises with flower/head production; Asteraceae head-size studies show positive size-predation associations
self_analysis_role: Provides a concrete mutualist-antagonist trade-off module
unresolved_reason: Independent studies do not share one harmonizable display effect estimand
decisive_next_data: Within-population display and density -> effective contact and antagonist damage -> seed fitness
claim_boundary: Do not claim bigger is better or pool slopes/correlations across estimands

hypothesis: Spines/phyllary architecture can deter antagonists but may impose pollinator-access costs
meta_or_existing_result: External Cardueae/Asteraceae manipulation shows inflorescence spines can deter illegitimate visitors and preserve filled seeds; Azami has only image proxies
unresolved_reason: Direct focal Cirsium spine/phyllary manipulation is absent
decisive_next_data: Validate botanical variation then manipulate access while measuring pollinator contacts damage and seed output
claim_boundary: External functional evidence cannot prove Cirsium adaptation

hypothesis: Sticky inflorescence exudate is a general reproductive defence
meta_or_existing_result: Neutralizing Cirsium discolor stickiness did not increase seed predators or reduce seed output
self_analysis_role: Negative-control lane; lowers priority of stickiness
unresolved_reason: One direct system does not exclude context-specific roles
decisive_next_data: Opportunistic only unless new focal evidence shows strong variation/association
claim_boundary: Do not promote stickiness as generic defence

hypothesis: Nodding/oriented capitula can improve reproductive function through time-window thermal/pollination and rain/wetting protection rather than static all-day pollinator preference
meta_or_existing_result: Cremanthodium nodding vs erect achene set about 3.586 with no static pollinator preference; rain/UV reduce pollen viability; EAzami mechanism reduction requires timing plus protection paths
unresolved_reason: External Asteraceae result is not Cirsium proof and total visits can be null
decisive_next_data: Randomized sham/reorientation with early/later contacts wetting pollen viability antagonist exposure and filled achenes
claim_boundary: ORI1-ORI5 preregistered; no mechanism claim before focal result

hypothesis: A young East Asian/Japanese Cirsium history created a short temporal window in which large capitulum disparity evolved
meta_or_existing_result: Published phylogenomics place the main Japan colonization/radiation in the Pleistocene; EAzami current sample has 36/38 Japanese concepts in one dominant young radiation
self_analysis_role: Turns global variation into a rapid-radiation test bed
unresolved_reason: Rapid radiation alone is not adaptive radiation
decisive_next_data: Aim1 ancestry plus Aim2 trait->fitness evidence
claim_boundary: Use rapid radiation now; reserve adaptive radiation until fitness link

hypothesis: Repeated capitulum states in the young radiation arise from reusable standing/introgressed/developmental modules rather than one shared whole-phenotype lability axis
meta_or_existing_result: Azami cross-module coupling is weak and one structural screen favours modular models, but robust held-out screen leaves common-lability nearly tied
unresolved_reason: Cross-study meta-analysis cannot identify within-radiation module covariance or ancestry source
decisive_next_data: Same-individual ancestry/plastid/cytotype plus multivariate module-specific trait->interaction->fitness paths
claim_boundary: Modular evolvability remains hypothesis not conclusion

hypothesis: White and coloured states can recur within closely related East Asian lineages and may represent repeated loss/regain or regulatory re-expression rather than taxonomic divergence
meta_or_existing_result: East Asian colour coding shows white/coloured states can occur within closely related lineages and colour taxonomy can mismatch phylogeny
self_analysis_role: Identifies repeated W/C systems for Aim1/Aim3
unresolved_reason: Tip states alone do not determine transition direction
decisive_next_data: Accepted branch-length nuclear tree plus population-aware colour states
claim_boundary: Repeated state occurrence is not yet demonstrated regain

hypothesis: A coloured Arenicola ancestor followed by white loss in C. brevicaule is favored only under a low transition-rate regime; colour regain in C. irumtiense remains viable
meta_or_existing_result: At q=0.2/Myr P(coloured MRCA)=0.919 on primary scaffold; expanded 10-tip/36-scenario analysis gives P(C)=0.955-0.966 at q=0.2, but LR95 supports rates to 100/Myr and P(C) to 0.5
self_analysis_role: Shows exactly why re-expression cannot yet be claimed
unresolved_reason: Transition rate and deep ancestor are not identifiable from current fixed-tip patterns
decisive_next_data: Accepted common-locus branch-length tree plus credible independent white placements and model-adequacy/rate check

hypothesis: If white states retain anthocyanin machinery via regulatory suppression then coloured states can reappear repeatedly without rebuilding the pathway
meta_or_existing_result: Across flowering plants anthocyanin losses can preserve structural pathway and some lineages regain floral pigmentation; other losses involve disabling/deletion and reduce reversibility
self_analysis_role: Makes colour reversibility a mechanistic flagship rather than a colour-frequency study
unresolved_reason: Cirsium pathway retention/regulatory reuse is not yet demonstrated in independent transitions
decisive_next_data: At least 2 W/C transitions with ancestry + coding/regulatory haplotype + matched floral RNA + pigment + calibrated colour
claim_boundary: No reactivation claim from DFR/ANS presence alone

hypothesis: Erect/nodding states have evolved repeatedly or in parallel within the East Asian radiation
meta_or_existing_result: Closely related East Asian Cirsium include both erect and nodding states and Japan image-authority overlap is directionally consistent, but current overlap n=8 is not significant
self_analysis_role: Defines a macroevolutionary repeatability test tied to ORI function
unresolved_reason: No trusted population-aware branch-length mapping yet; image vertical is a proxy
decisive_next_data: Botanical orientation states mapped to accepted nuclear tree and stochastic/transition analysis; then compare independent transitions functionally
claim_boundary: Do not call parallel evolution before independent transitions are reconstructed

hypothesis: Independent colour and orientation transitions are ecologically parallel if they repeatedly enter the same environmental/interaction gate even when genetic changes differ
meta_or_existing_result: Global Azami identifies environmental structure; selection-mosaic meta shows local gates; East Asian rapid radiation supplies replicate transitions
self_analysis_role: Connects global pattern to evolutionary-history significance
unresolved_reason: Requires both independent-transition inference and comparable focal functional measurements
decisive_next_data: Replicated transition pairs with ancestry-resolved environment pollination antagonism and fitness
claim_boundary: Parallel ecology and molecular parallelism must be tested separately
